integrity: Self-contained analytic two-mode proof, symbolic independent tilted-generator check, and 125 deterministic finite-time matrix-exponential tests; external validation and priority audit unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary three-state Markov population rates at aggregate work stall; labelled signed jump counts; known aggregate rates; does not extend to explicit quantum filters, batteries, off-stall conditions or finite-sample guarantees.
title: Strict finite-time work–leak anticorrelation and stall-point rate identification
